name: School
definition: A California public school or school agency listed in the statewide school directory; each row is a CDS code carrying names, location, classification and status.
scope: School-level analysis over tab03; includes 1369 district/agency rows that have no school name.

name: School District
definition: The administrative district or agency that operates a school, identified by its district name, which is repeated on every school row belonging to that district.
scope: tab03.fld045, tab02.fld033 and tab01.fld007; the database has no separate district table or district identifier.

name: County
definition: California county in which a school or district is located.
scope: Text attribute on school, SAT and meal records; 58 distinct values in the school directory.

name: City
definition: City of the school street address.
scope: tab03.fld049 only; 1165 distinct values and 293 blank rows. City names also appear inside county and district names.

name: CDS Code
definition: Fourteen-digit California County-District-School identifier; the primary key of a school and the join key between the school directory and the meal-eligibility report.
scope: tab03.fld001 and tab01.fld001; both are 14 characters in every row.

name: SAT Report CDS Code
definition: CDS code as recorded on SAT score records; it designates the same school or district but 211 rows store only 13 characters because a leading zero was dropped.
scope: tab02.fld030; must be normalized before comparison with 14-character CDS codes.

name: School Status
definition: Operating status of the directory record: Active, Closed, Merged or Pending.
scope: tab03.fld043.

name: School Type
definition: CDE school type classification; the numeric code in fld067 is paired with the descriptive label in fld068.
scope: tab03.fld067 and fld068; describes the school itself, not its district.

name: District Type
definition: CDE district type classification, such as Unified School District, Elementary School District, High School District or County Office of Education.
scope: tab03.fld065 and fld066 (tab01.fld009 carries the description); it classifies the operating district, not the school.

name: Educational Option Type
definition: CDE educational option classification of a school, for example Traditional, Continuation School, Special Education School or State Special School (SSS).
scope: tab03.fld069 (code) and fld070 (description); tab01.fld011 carries the description only.

name: State Special School
definition: A public school whose educational option type is SSS; three schools statewide, including the California School for the Blind and the California School for the Deaf campuses.
scope: Subset of tab03 identified by fld069 = 'SSS'.

name: High School
definition: A school whose CDE school type is High Schools (Public), code 66.
scope: Subset of tab03 identified by fld067 = '66'; excludes continuation high schools, junior high schools, K-12 schools and High Schools In 1 School Dist.

name: Grade Span
definition: Text range of grades offered by a school, such as K-5, K-8, 6-8, 9-12 or Adult; K denotes Kindergarten.
scope: tab03.fld073, the more complete of the two grade-span columns.

name: Alternate Grade Span
definition: A second grade-span field on the school directory that encodes the same concept as the primary grade span but is populated for fewer schools and disagrees for 2487 rows.
scope: tab03.fld074; never populated when fld073 is blank.

name: Magnet Program
definition: Indicator that a school offers a magnet program; 1 means it offers one and 0 means it does not.
scope: tab03.fld076; blank for 7076 rows.

name: Virtual School Status
definition: Coded virtual-instruction status of a school; F denotes a school that is exclusively virtual.
scope: tab03.fld075; observed values F, N, P and blank.

name: School Address
definition: Physical street address of a school, composed of street, city, state and ZIP code.
scope: tab03.fld047, fld049, fld051 and fld050; mailing-address columns fld052-fld056 form a separate address and are not covered by this term.

name: School Location
definition: Geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude) of a school.
scope: tab03.fld077 and fld078; blank for 4823 rows.

name: School Administrator
definition: Administrator contact recorded on the school row: first name, last name and e-mail address.
scope: tab03.fld079-fld081 for the primary administrator; fld082-fld087 hold a second contact for 431 schools and a third for 42.

name: School Open Date
definition: Date on which the school opened.
scope: tab03.fld060, a text date from 1850-07-01 to 2017-09-22; blank for the 1369 agency rows.

name: SAT Score Report
definition: One SAT performance record for a reporting unit, which may be a school or a district.
scope: tab02; 1749 school-level and 520 district-level records.

name: SAT Record Type
definition: Type of reporting unit on a SAT record: S for school and D for district.
scope: tab02.fld031.

name: SAT Test Taker Count
definition: Number of students who took the SAT at the reporting unit.
scope: tab02.fld036; 218 records have zero test takers.

name: Average SAT Reading Score
definition: Average SAT reading score of the reporting unit test takers.
scope: tab02.fld037; observed range 308-653 and null for 596 records.

name: Average SAT Math Score
definition: Average SAT mathematics score of the reporting unit test takers.
scope: tab02.fld038; observed range 289-699 and null for 596 records.

name: Average SAT Writing Score
definition: Average SAT writing score of the reporting unit test takers.
scope: tab02.fld039; observed range 312-671 and null for 596 records.

name: SAT Test Takers Scoring 1500 or Above
definition: Number of the reporting unit SAT test takers whose total score is at least 1500.
scope: tab02.fld040; a non-negative count, observed 0-5837.

name: Excellence Rate
definition: Share of SAT test takers whose total score is at least 1500, computed as fld040 divided by fld036.
scope: Derived per SAT record; tab02 stores no percentage column for it.

name: FRPM / Meal Eligibility Report
definition: Annual free and reduced-price meal (FRPM) report for a school, including enrollment and meal-eligible counts.
scope: tab01; one row per school for the 2014-2015 academic year.

name: Academic Year
definition: School year to which a meal-eligibility record belongs.
scope: tab01.fld002; only 2014-2015 is present.

name: Enrollment (K-12)
definition: Total number of students enrolled in kindergarten through grade 12 at the school.
scope: tab01.fld019; combines elementary and secondary enrollment.

name: Free Meal Count (K-12)
definition: Number of K-12 students eligible for free meals.
scope: tab01.fld020; never exceeds the FRPM count and is null for 56 records.

name: Eligible Free Rate (K-12)
definition: Proportion of K-12 enrollment eligible for free meals, equal to fld020 divided by fld019.
scope: tab01.fld021 stores the fraction between 0 and 1; it is not a percentage.

name: Enrollment (Ages 5-17)
definition: Number of students aged 5 to 17 enrolled at the school; a subgroup of K-12 enrollment.
scope: tab01.fld024; never exceeds fld019 and is null for 14 records.

name: FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)
definition: Number of students aged 5 to 17 eligible for free or reduced-price meals.
scope: tab01.fld027; the age-based FRPM count, distinct from the K-12 FRPM count.
aliases: free or reduced price meals ages 5-17

name: NSLP Provision Status
definition: National School Lunch Program provision type recorded for a school, for example Provision 2, CEP or Multiple Provision Types.
scope: tab01.fld012; blank for 8139 of 9986 rows.
